groups.name: pc_port
groups.why: DB25 to the PC parallel port with its 100R series resistors on D0-D4 (R6-R10, J1 to U1 inputs), the 47R series resistor R4 on the DONE->SELECT return (U2 output to J1.13), and the VCC-sense chain D1 (BAT46) + R1 100R feeding ERROR (J1.15): every part whose far pad is a J1 pin

groups.name: core
groups.why: the two 74LS125 quad tri-state buffers (U1 drives TDI/TCK/TMS and the open-drain PROG/DONE line, U2A reads DONE back), the 5k1 pull-up R2 on U1A-O, and C1 1uF, the only VCC decap

groups.name: outputs
groups.why: the buffered outputs to the target: 100R series resistors R11-R14 and the 100pF edge-slowing caps C2-C5 on the U1 outputs (on the U1 side of each resistor); a bridge between U1's output pins and J2/P1

groups.name: target
groups.why: the target-side connectors: DB9 J2 (bottom side, east edge) and the 1x6 flying-lead header P1, wired pin for pin to the same five signals plus GND

groups.name: power
groups.why: power entry from the target: D2 (BAT46) from PWR_3,3-5V (J2.1/P1.1) to VCC, and R5 1k VCC-to-GND bleed; sits by its entry (the target connectors), not at an edge
